profile.name: 梅特勒-托利多实验室天平
profile.description: 实验室电子天平，用于对样品、试剂或容器进行高精度称量。该类天平通常支持去皮、清零和读取重量，适用于分析称量、配液配样及常规质量测量。
profile.description_en: An electronic laboratory balance used for precise weighing of samples, reagents, and containers. This type of balance typically supports tare, zeroing, and weight readout, and is used for analytical weighing, sample preparation, and routine mass measurements in the lab.
